name: @islee23520/lfp
description: LazyCodex extension plugin for Codex model/provider configuration, category routing guidance, and MCP fallback lookup.
author: islee23520

interface.displayName: LFP — Full OMO Bridge for Codex
interface.shortDescription: Extends LazyCodex with model/provider setup, category routing guidance, and MCP fallback lookup.
interface.longDescription: LFP keeps LazyCodex/OMO agents as the source of truth and focuses on model operations: provider setup, configurable primary model fields, category-based model routing guidance, an MCP tool for manual fallback lookup from saved override configurations, interactive TUI setup, and atomic runtime promotion with rollback.
defaultPrompt: Use LFP to configure LazyCodex/OMO model routing and provider defaults.
Use the model_fallback_resolver tool when a configured agent hits quota, rate-limit, or provider failure.
Keep agent behavior owned by LazyCodex/OMO; LFP only manages supported model fields and saved fallback lookup.

tools.name: model_fallback_resolver
tools.description: MCP tool for manual fallback lookup. Given an agent name and optional error reason (quota, rate-limit, 429, error), returns the effective model from saved override configurations (primary or configured fallback). Never writes anything. Safe to call from any agent on quota/rate/provider failure.

agent.description: Agent name, e.g. explorer, metis, plan, momus

reason.description: Optional error category that triggers fallback: quota, rate-limit, 429, error, fail
